title: Interim Finance Officer
description:
Interim Finance Officer

Location: Bradford
Salary: £28,000 - £33,000 per annum, depending on experience
Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, with potential to become permanent
Hours: Full-time, 1 day a week in the office

We are recruiting for a Finance Officer to join a busy finance team in Bradford on an initial six-month fixed-term contract, with the potential for the role to become permanent for the right person.

This is a varied finance position covering accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger activities, making it an excellent opportunity for either an experienced Finance Officer or a high-potential junior finance professional looking to develop their career.

The Role

Working as part of the finance team, you will support a broad range of day-to-day financial processes and help ensure transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions.
- Supporting general ledger activities and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Preparing and processing payment runs.
- Completing bank and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Assisting with double-entry bookkeeping.
- Uploading and processing housing benefit schedules.
- Supporting the wider finance team with day-to-day accounting requirements.
- Investigating and resolving financial queries where required.
- Ensuring financial information is accurate, complete and processed within agreed timescales.
- Contributing to the ongoing improvement of finance processes and systems.

About You

We are open to considering candidates at different stages of their finance career.

We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
- Experience within a finance administration, accounts or Finance Officer position.
- Exposure to accounts payable and/or accounts receivable.
- Good knowledge of Excel and confidence working with financial data.
- Ideally, experience using Excel lookups and pivot tables, or the aptitude to develop these skills quickly.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- The initiative to identify issues and find solutions rather than simply follow processes.
- A proactive and collaborative approach to working.

Experience within the housing sector would be advantageous, as would experience of HomeMaster, although neither is essential.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a role that offers both variety and development.

For a junior candidate, the position provides the opportunity to broaden your experience across AP, AR and general ledger functions while developing your technical finance skills.

For a more experienced Finance Officer, the role offers the opportunity to take ownership of a varied workload and use your existing systems and process knowledge to make an immediate contribution.

The initial contract is for six months, with the potential for the position to become permanent for the successful candidate.

If you're an ambitious junior finance professional or an experienced Finance Officer looking for your next opportunity in Bradford, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Location: Leeds, UK

Salary: £25k-£28.5k depending on experience

Type: Full time

About Dream Big Digital

Dream Big Digital is a boutique eCommerce and marketing agency based in Leeds, Yorkshire. We specialise in designing, building, and marketing online Shopify stores that excite customers and generate revenue. Our small but mighty team is passionate about helping ambitious brands sell more online through tailored, personal service.

We're looking for a Social Media Coordinator to join the team and support the delivery of high-performing social content and influencer collaborations across our ecommerce client portfolio.

The Role

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone with a strong interest in social media, content and eCommerce marketing. Working closely with our Marketing Director, designers and wider team, you'll help plan and deliver engaging social media activity across a range of eCommerce brands, alongside supporting influencer campaigns.

A key part of the role will be coming up with creative ideas that help brands stand out on social, turning marketing priorities, products and promotions into engaging content. You'll be involved in everything from planning content calendars and writing copy to briefing creative, coordinating influencers and reviewing what's performing.

You don't need to be a specialist in every area. We're looking for someone who is creative, organised, commercially aware and genuinely excited by social media, while being comfortable managing a varied workload across multiple brands.

Experience managing organic social media for eCommerce brands would be a big advantage.

What You'll Be Doing
- Planning and supporting organic social media activity across a range of eCommerce brands
- Developing creative ideas for social posts, campaigns, Reels and other short-form content
- Writing engaging, on-brand social media copy
- Creating and managing social content calendars around key campaigns, launches, trends and seasonal moments
- Briefing designers and content creators on social assets and creative requirements
- Supporting the creation of simple social-first content, including capturing photos and short-form video where required
- Coordinating influencer and creator activity, including outreach, gifting and collaborations
- Keeping up to date with social media trends, platform developments and emerging content formats
- Reviewing social performance and using insights to help shape future content
- Writing marketing copy for blogs, landing pages and other digital content
- Working closely with the wider team to ensure client activity is delivered accurately and on time

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a social media, digital marketing, eCommerce or similar role
- Hands-on experience managing or supporting organic social media for brands
- A strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook and TikTok and the types of content that work across each platform
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills
- Confidence developing creative content ideas and contributing to campaign planning
- A good eye for engaging social content and current trends
- Good commercial awareness and an understanding of how social media can support brand awareness, engagement, traffic and sales
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Confidence managing multiple brands, tasks and deadlines
- The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a small team
- A genuine interest in social media, eCommerce and digital marketing

Particularly Useful Experience
- These aren't essential, but we'd particularly love to hear from you if you have experience with:
- Creating social content for eCommerce or consumer brands
- Planning and managing social media content calendars
- Influencer marketing, creator outreach or Shopify Collabs
- Creating or editing simple Reels and short-form video content
- Google Analytics or social media reporting tools
- Working within an eCommerce brand or digital agency

Benefits

The opportunity to work across a variety of exciting eCommerce brands and industries within a growing Shopify Plus Partner

A supportive, collaborative and creative working environment

Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

Real responsibility and ownership - your work will directly impact client growth

Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid working (home-based with two days in Leeds city centre)

Part of a growing, innovative team

25 days holiday plus bank holidays
